default_case.proposition: The actual exact member candidate is a stated static default in the selected build; this case is independent of the loaded registration case.

default_lifetime_valid.proposition: Every invocation in the static-default case has live code and opaque context through the last invocation; no loaded-envelope truth follows.

environment.proposition: Exact selected PluginPremiseDecomposition.Environment including every loaded RK and Fluent Bit C/Go artifact, every callback event, build/ABI/inventory and full context; source trace completeness remains Open.

invoke.proposition: Admission of every reached rk_conf callback invocation under the selected rd_kafka_dump0 callback-closure premise; not permission inferred from a sampled callback.

plugin_artifact_symbol_abi.proposition: For every reached loaded artifact, exact selected build/inventory, artifact identity and required symbol/address/ABI prerequisites hold.

plugin_callback_candidates.proposition: Every actual rk_conf invocation has its exact declared member candidate and a prior successful public registration or stated static default.

plugin_code_context_lifetime.proposition: Every loaded callback invocation, including destruction and copied on_new paths, has live code and opaque context.

plugin_interceptor_custody.proposition: Every interceptor-descendant pointer and scalar resource is borrowed, with no retain/transfer/global custody and each local acquisition dropped before its activation returns.

plugin_interceptor_registration.proposition: Every loaded interceptor uses a successful public setter with the exact pinned list/union-arm candidate and permitted configuration/client lifecycle.

plugin_lifecycle_unload.proposition: Every callback invocation precedes matching final unload and copied registrations retain actual loader references.

plugin_outer_bridge.proposition: Actually loaded RK and Fluent Bit C/Go code independently meet their respectively bound proposed outer envelopes; one envelope covers no missing obligation of another.

registered_case.proposition: The actual exact member candidate was registered by a prior successful public registration in this selected trace.

registered_lifetime_valid.proposition: Every invocation in the registered case has live code and opaque context and precedes matching final unload, including destruction and copied registrations.

unregistered.proposition: Positive evidence that a reached callback has neither its required successful public registration nor a stated static default; failed registration proof alone does not establish this.

boundary: Proposed guarded obligations bound to actual existing source hypotheses. Dependencies are not equivalence/implication proofs. No inline adoption or source-truth receipt.
source_correspondence: open; formal propositions are conditional model definitions, not statements proved of imported C
